newsitem.title: USA: Four Gillette officers sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Four Gillette officers sell shares.

text.p: Four senior executives of Gillette Co, including the chairman of board, reduced their stake in the company recently, selling off shares of common stock, according to the Securities and Exchange Commission.
In Form 4 filings released earlier this week, Alfred Zeien, chairman and chief executive officer, said he sold 19,000 common shares on September 26 at $69.25 per share.

Thomas Skelly, senior vice president, said he sold 27,626 common shares on September 30 at $72 per share, while Robert DiCenso, senior vice president for personnel and administration said he sold 4,500 common shares on September 27 at $71.25 per share, the filing showed.
Jacques Lagarde, executive vice-president, said he sold 2,100 common shares on October 1 for $72.25 per share, according to the filing.
Form 4 filings do not reveal the size of the stake officers hold in their respective companies.
On September 12, Gillette announced it will acquire battery maker Duracell International Inc for about $7 billion in stock.
